info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the updating of transaction authorizations across multiple channels using a specified parameter. It allows businesses to ensure that authorization details are synchronized effectively, which is essential for seamless customer transactions. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and financial services platforms that require dynamic control over transaction processing. By leveraging this functionality, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and improve the customer experience.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to partially update the details of a specific transaction authorization identified by its reference ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request body to apply the updates successfully.

requestBody.description: The request body for the patch operation to authorize a cross-channel transaction. It should contain the necessary fields as defined in the specified schema.

200.description: The transaction authorization was successfully updated.
